adaptations: Only prompt string constants retained; original network client is not executed.
Strict yes/no parsing replaces substring matching.
A fixed instruction/data guard is added as a system message; requested judge model can differ from original paper.
No chain-of-thought or grading reason is requested because upstream asks yes/no only.
All runs are labelled adapted model-assisted grading, not official benchmark or human/clinical evaluation.
